paper.label: Temporal-National (paper model)
paper.note: Temporal-National configuration as released in v2.0.0, measured on the held-out 20% of the 797,744 observations (random_state=42); complete ERA5 inputs required. The manuscript reports a model of this configuration refit under the revised evaluation protocol.

sensor_temporal.label: Sensor-only temporal
sensor_temporal.note: Deployment model trained for the web app; six prior hourly records recommended.

instant.label: Sensor-only instant
instant.note: Warm-up model for isolated readings or the first six hours of a sequence.
